title: ControlPlaneAllowanceReading
description: SPEC §25.1, §25.2: what the machine's `allowance_cmd` prints: any number of named usage windows, each with its percentage used (0 or more; a figure past 100 is kept as read) and its reset time. Either the generic form, or the legacy one: an object per window with `utilization` and `resets_at` (e.g. `five_hour`, `seven_day`). Either may carry `retry_after_s`, the seconds to wait before the command is run again; an object holding only `retry_after_s` is a failed read that says when to retry. A window whose figure is null or missing keeps its reset and gates nothing; a reading with no window figure is a failed read, never zero.

name.description: The window's name; `telemetry.windows` gives it a kind and a threshold

pct.description: Percentage of the window's allowance used

retry_after_s.description: SPEC §25.1: seconds before the command is run again; the shared reader backs off at least this long, at most 3600 seconds.
